curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the line between protector and target blurs, how long can an outsider remain hidden inside a world that lives apart?
curatedMovie.description: After an Amish boy witnesses a brutal murder, the detective assigned to shield him and his mother finds his own life in jeopardy, compelling him to hide within their quiet, insular community.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, emotionally weighty, and deliberate, balancing acute danger with an observant, secluded atmosphere.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Peter Weir, this tense crime drama pairs lethal stakes with the steady, contemplative rhythms of life in an unfamiliar world.
